title: 1996 Topps Season Highlights #465 Barry Bonds San Francisco Giants
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a rare and highly sought-after Barry Bonds 1996 Topps Season Highlights trading card, numbered 465, featuring the San Francisco Giants player in his iconic baseball gear. The card is made of durable card stock with a thickness of 20 Pt. and is an original, licensed reprint from the 1996 Topps set. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection and a must-have for fans of the Major League (MLB).

The card is in standard size and has not been autographed or signed by the player. It is a base set card and was manufactured by Topps in the United States. This trading card is perfect for collectors and enthusiasts who want to own a piece of baseball history and add a valuable item to their collection.
